closure.closure_role: cross-module contract hardening, API normalization, and compiler evidence
closure.adr05_pointwise_name_collision: ADR-06 reserves PointwiseRel for same-input agreement and names the old related-input lifting CrossRel.

included: explicit RelSpec, Respects, same-input PointwiseRel, and CrossRel bridges
OptionRel, EffectResultRel, ExecRel, and dependent-store relator shells

partial operation tags, outcomes, selected-inverse coherence, and D39 stability hooks

CoreStateObs pullback and distinct observation-profile boundaries
alpha transport for state, inverses, stages, iterators, execution, and traces

relation_vocabulary.RelSpec: explicit reflexive, symmetric, transitive relation value
relation_vocabulary.PointwiseRel: same-input relation forall z, R (f z) (g z)
relation_vocabulary.CrossRel: related-input relation forall {x y}, R x y -> R (f x) (g y)
relation_vocabulary.equivalence_bridge: CrossRel implies PointwiseRel and, for RelSpec, endpoint Respects; directed simulations must use a separate relation package
relation_vocabulary.compatibility: ADR-05's former PointwiseRel spelling is an editorial/API correction, not a semantic carrier change

relators_and_observations.option: none relates only to none; some payloads use the supplied relation
relators_and_observations.effect_result: successor state plus same-input-related selected inverse
relators_and_observations.execution_result: success/failure tags are explicit; failure relates error, final prefix state, and prefix inverse
relators_and_observations.dependent_store: DepStoreObs and depStoreObsSpec provide a pointwise schema; ADR-02 Finmap remains authoritative
relators_and_observations.profile_rule: no automatic refinement or coercion between named observation profiles

effects.composition: seqRun_lawful proves exact sequential closure with outer-after-inner inverse composition
effects.equality: lawful_equality_iff recovers the repaired exact witness condition
effects.tracked_context: T15/T16 accumulator and lift proofs remain an implementation bridge, not claimed by this standalone Effect shell

independence.non_vacuity: TransformationMonoidProfile supplies identity/composition closure; GeneratedEffectProfile records forward and every returned-undo generator
independence.leastness: equality with the paper's least generated monoid is a D17/L18 proof obligation, not an axiom

partial_operations.outcome_policy: ordinary outcomes use equality unless an explicit outcome relation is supplied
partial_operations.L35: weak congruence, selected-inverse coherence, and recovery are separate; finite Toy countermodel shows weak properness does not imply coherence

iterator.carrier: ADR-05 RankedIterator with Nat rank and StageResult halt/yield/raise
iterator.bisimulation: the reverse simulation uses converse continuation relation fun q q' => C q' q
iterator.transport: execFrom_rel uses a sum-rank induction measure and directional simulation; equal ranks are not assumed
iterator.D60_hook: ContinuationStable and IteratorIndependenceContract package state/inverse/continuation stability with commutation and properness
iterator.D60_boundary: the exact reach-closed, yielded-only generated monoid specialization remains a downstream integration obligation

alpha_equivariance.action: AlphaAction with identity, composition, and inverse/cancellation laws
alpha_equivariance.payload_boundary: Q and Xi are unchanged in the compiled profile; name-bearing payloads require explicit actions and interpreter refinement

L38.form: generated theorem manifest and relation-parametric specialization
L38.rule: do not perform a textual global replacement of equality by an observational glyph
L38.exact_specialization: equality Γ supplies the Section-3.1 exact instance
